core_problem_solved: To provide an easy-to-use and lightweight framework for serializing Java objects to XML and deserializing them back, using annotations to map fields to XML elements and attributes.
key_features: A small footprint, making it suitable for memory-constrained environments like Android
A focus on simplicity and ease of use over the full JAXB feature set
era_and_niche: A popular XML data-binding library, particularly in the Android and lightweight application space, known for its simplicity compared to the more complex JAXB standard at the time.
reason_for_obsolescence: This is a **legacy library**. While it is a well-designed library that still works, it has not seen significant feature development in many years. The Java world has largely standardized on the **Jackson XML extension** (`com.fasterxml.jackson.dataformat:jackson-dataformat-xml`) for high-performance, feature-rich XML data binding, or the standard **Jakarta XML Binding (JAXB)** for enterprise applications.
